description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various methods across three different domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The methods compared are DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO, and PPO, each represented by a distinct color and pattern as indicated in the legend. In the Mathverse domain, the accuracy values are approximately 53% for DAPO, 56% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53.5% for GRPO, 56% for SRPO, and 53.2% for PPO. For MMLU, the accuracies are around 56% for DAPO, 57% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 55.8% for GRPO, 57.2% for SRPO, and 54.6% for PPO. In the Physics domain, the accuracies are approximately 57.5% for DAPO, 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58.2% for GRPO, 60.5% for SRPO, and 57% for PPO. Across all domains, DAPO+Self-reflection generally achieves the highest accuracy, followed by SRPO and then GRPO, while PPO consistently shows the lowest accuracy among the compared methods.
